_howto: Contractors tours. steps = page tour. sections = one tour per screen plus pop-up form tours. Guides in contractors_guides.json.
title: Contractors tour
whatsNewText: We've added something new here since you last took the tour.

steps.title: Welcome to Contractors & Distribution
steps.text:
Register farmers, give them contracts, distribute inputs through your warehouses, and follow their progress, with approvals along the way.

Use Next and Back, or your arrow keys. Press Esc to close.

steps.title: All screens
steps.text: Grouped by what you do. Click a group title to open or close it. Set up in this order: Settings, Locations Master, Contractors Hierarchy, Workflow, then farmers and contracts.

steps.title: Dashboard
steps.text: Farmers, contracts, distribution and progress at a glance.

steps.title: Farmers Master
steps.text: Every farmer or contractor: profile, photo, biometrics, location and their own fields.

steps.title: Contract Management
steps.text: Contracts per farmer: assign one from a template, follow its approval, and manage your templates.

steps.title: Inbox
steps.text: Contracts and distributions waiting for your approval.

steps.title: Distribution Master
steps.text: Inputs given to farmers and returns: cycles, warehouses, stock items, receiving stock, transfers and the logs from the app.

steps.title: Progress
steps.text: How far each area and farmer is, per cycle.

steps.title: Reports
steps.text: Farmer, contract and distribution reports, and scheduled report emails.

steps.title: SMS & Broadcast
steps.text: Messages to farmers by SMS, and broadcasts to your team.

steps.title: Contractors Hierarchy
steps.text: Your structure (for example region > area > field officer) and who manages which part.

steps.title: Locations Master
steps.text: The areas farmers belong to, imported from a spreadsheet or added one by one.

steps.title: Workflow
steps.text: Who approves contracts and distributions, per level, and stand-ins.

steps.title: Audit Log
steps.text: Every change, who made it and when.

steps.title: Settings
steps.text: Currency, contract and distribution rules, seasons, tobacco types and your own fields.

steps.title: Make more room
steps.text: Collapse the menu to icons only, and click again to open it.

steps.title: Search any screen
steps.text: Jump straight to any screen you have access to, in any module.

steps.title: Your menu
steps.text: Your profile, other areas of the system, Dark Mode and logout.

steps.title: Help & Tours
steps.text: Opens the same help menu as the ? button.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.text: Click ? for this tour, a tour of the screen you're on, and how-to guides.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.text: Each screen also has its own short tour. It starts the first time you open that screen, and you can replay it any time from ?.

steps.title: Find a farmer
steps.text: Search by name, number or ID. Filters narrow by area or missing details (photo, biometrics).

steps.title: Add Contractor
steps.text: A new farmer or contractor with their details, area and location.

steps.title: Data Tools
steps.text: Import farmers from a spreadsheet (with a preview before anything changes), export them, and see import history.

steps.title: Active and deactivated
steps.text: Deactivated profiles are kept, and can be restored.

steps.title: Your farmers
steps.text: Open a farmer to see and change their profile, contracts and distributions.

steps.title: Contracts and templates
steps.text: Manage Contracts: every farmer's contract. Contract Templates: the contracts you give out, written or imported as PDF.

steps.title: Assign Contract
steps.text: Give a farmer a contract from a template, with its dates, size, product and field location. It then goes through your approval workflow.

steps.title: Find a contract
steps.text: Search, or filter by area, status (approved, in workflow, expired), expiry and approver.

steps.title: Levels and managers
steps.text: Hierarchy Levels: your structure as a tree. Manager Assignments: who manages each part.

steps.title: Add Level
steps.text: Add a level, for example a region, then the areas or teams under it.

steps.title: Your structure
steps.text: Open or collapse each branch.

steps.title: Manager Assignments
steps.text: Who manages which part of the structure. Assign many at once from a spreadsheet with Data Tools; you check a preview first.

steps.title: Import areas
steps.text: Download the template, fill it in, and import. Import History shows past imports.

steps.title: Add Area
steps.text: One area at a time, at its level in your structure.

steps.title: Your areas
steps.text: Search, or filter by level.

steps.title: Contracts or distribution
steps.text: Approval rules are set separately for contracts, and for distribution (inputs and returns).

steps.title: Who approves
steps.text: Per level: whether it needs approval and who approves it. Then Save Rules.

steps.title: Try it
steps.text: Pick an area to see exactly who a contract or distribution there would go to.

steps.title: Stand-ins
steps.text: Someone approves for another person while they are away, between two dates.

steps.title: Currency
steps.text: The currency for all values in this module.

steps.title: Distribution and contract rules
steps.text: Whether inputs may go to farmers without a contract, with a pending or expired contract, whether a farmer may have more than one contract, and the value above which a distribution needs extra approval.

steps.title: Witness Rules
steps.text: Switch on Single-farmer clubs and a club with only one farmer is witnessed by a person who types their name and surname and signs on the phone, instead of the field technician. It is required before the club can be finished. Place the Club Witness boxes on your club contract template (Contract Templates); until you do, this witness prints in the Field Technician (Witness) boxes. Click Save Rules; phones use it after their next Sync.

steps.title: Seasons
steps.text: Your growing seasons (cycle years) with their dates.

steps.title: Tobacco types
steps.text: The products farmers grow under contract.

steps.title: Distribution
steps.text: Incoming Logs from the app, Live Inventory & Transfers, Receive Stock (GRV), Cycles, Warehouses and Stock Items. Set up warehouses, items and a cycle first.
